# DZVNbeats
> Official music portfolio, beat store, and licensing platform for independent music producer Denzven Vadakkan (DZVN).

DZVNbeats provides premium type beats, hard-hitting rap instrumentals, trap beats, UK/NY drill tracks, and atmospheric R&B productions. Available for free non-commercial download and instant commercial licensing with stems.

## Core Information
- **Producer / Audio Engineer**: Denzven Vadakkan (also known as Denzven, DZVN, @dzvn_editsss)
- **Studio Rating**: ★★★★★ 4.9/5 (140+ verified artist licenses and reviews)
- **Location**: Mumbai, India
- **Primary Website**: https://denzven.github.io/DZVNbeats/
- **Inquiries & Custom Production**: dzvn.beats@gmail.com
- **Instagram**: https://instagram.com/dzvn_editsss (@dzvn_editsss)
- **YouTube Channel**: https://www.youtube.com/@DZVNbeats
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/denzven

## Premium Type Beats & Artist Styles
DZVNbeats is an independent beat store providing free beat downloads and commercial licenses for rap and hip-hop artists. Available artist styles include:
- Drake type beat, Travis Scott type beat, Future type beat, Metro Boomin type beat, Playboi Carti type beat
- Lil Uzi Vert type beat, 21 Savage type beat, J. Cole type beat, Kendrick Lamar type beat, Gunna type beat
- Lil Baby type beat, Young Thug type beat, Don Toliver type beat, The Weeknd type beat, Bryson Tiller type beat
- Partynextdoor type beat, Brent Faiyaz type beat, Pop Smoke type beat, Central Cee type beat, Chief Keef type beat
- Yeat type beat, Ken Carson type beat, Destroy Lonely type beat, Lil Tecca type beat, Juice WRLD type beat
- XXXTentacion type beat, Polo G type beat, Roddy Ricch type beat, NBA Youngboy type beat

## Licensing Tiers & Pricing
1. **Free (Tagged MP3)**: Free evaluation, non-commercial demos, non-monetized streaming on SoundCloud or YouTube with credit "(Prod. DZVN)".
2. **Basic Commercial Lease (₹200 / ~$2.50 USD)**: Untagged high-definition 24-bit WAV file, up to 50,000 commercial audio streams, 1 monetized music video, non-exclusive commercial rights.
3. **Exclusive Purchase Contract (₹1,000 / ~$12.00 USD)**: Full master ownership transfer, separated dry 24-bit WAV track stems, and unlimited commercial distribution.
